programme.title: El Clasico Legends: James Rodríguez

programme.title: El Clasico Legends: Álvaro Arbeloa

programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Lenovo Japanese Grand Prix'. The Japanese GP was won by Max Verstappen, who fended off a race-long challenge from the two McLarens of Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Bahrain GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Bahrain Grand Prix'. Oscar Piastri of McLaren converted his pole position to a victory, ahead of George Russell of Mercedes and Piastri's teammate Lando Norris.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Saudi Arabia GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - STC Saudi Arabian Grand Prix'. Oscar Piastri won the 2025 Saudi Arabian GP, taking the WDC lead for McLaren. Verstappen took P2 despite a 5s penalty, with Leclerc P3.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Miami GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Crypto.com Miami Grand Prix'. Piastri storms to victory at the 2025 Miami GP, leading a McLaren 1-2 with Norris. Russell takes third as Verstappen slips to fourth after losing the lead on lap 14.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Emilia-Romagna GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - AWS Gran Premio Del Made in Italy E Dell'Emilia-Romagna'. Verstappen triumphs at Imola, winning the Emilia-Romagna GP ahead of Norris and Piastri.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Monaco GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Grand Prix De Monaco'. Norris won from pole, holding off Leclerc. Piastri P3. Verstappen P4 after a late tire gamble failed. Norris's win cut the title lead to 3 points in a strategic race.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Canada GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Pirelli Grand Prix Du Canada'. Russell claims pole-to-flag win in Montreal, with Verstappen second and rookie Antonelli third. Russell nabbed fastest lap, McLaren's Norris and Piastri collide late.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Austrian GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - MSC Cruises Austrian Grand Prix'. Norris won at the Red Bull Ring. Piastri P2 ensured McLaren dominance on Red Bull's turf with Leclerc finishing P3.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: British GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Qatar Airways British Grand Prix'. Norris won a wet-dry home GP. Piastri P2, with Hulkenberg a shock P3 for Sauber.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Belgian GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Belgian Grand Prix'. Piastri won at Spa. Norris P2, Leclerc P3. McLaren extended their Constructors' lead significantly over Red Bull.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Hungarian GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Lenovo Hungarian Grand Prix'. Lando Norris wins for McLaren, narrowly beating his teammate Oscar Piastri in a thrilling finish, marking McLaren's 200th F1 win.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Netherlands GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Heineken Dutch Grand Prix'. Piastri spoiled Verstappen's home party with a win. Verstappen P2, Hadjar a shock P3 for RB.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Italy GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Pirelli Gran Premio D'Italia'. Verstappen won at Monza. Norris P2, Piastri P3. Ferrari missed the home podium as Leclerc finished P4.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Azerbaijan GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Qatar Airways Azerbaijan Grand Prix'. Verstappen mastered the Baku streets to win from pole. Russell P2, while Carlos Sainz took a maiden Williams podium in P3.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Singapore GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Singapore Airlines Singapore Grand Prix'. George Russell converted pole into a brilliant win. Verstappen took P2 after holding off a fierce charge from Norris (P3).

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: United States GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - MSC Cruises United States Grand Prix'. Verstappen dominated the weekend, winning both the Sprint and the Grand Prix. Norris beat Leclerc to P2 after a thrilling late-race duel.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Mexico GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Gran Premio De La Ciudad De Mexico'. Norris won from pole, Leclerc took P2, while Verstappen fought from P5 to P3. Rookie Ollie Bearman secured a career-best P4 for Haas.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Sao Paulo GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - MSC Cruises Grande Premio De Sao Paulo'. Norris mastered the rain at Interlagos to win both the Sprint and Grand Prix. Kimi Antonelli took a sensational P2 for Mercedes, with Verstappen P3.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Las Vegas GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Heineken Las Vegas Grand Prix'. Verstappen won a cold, chaotic night race. Russell and Antonelli followed for a Mercedes 2-3. Both McLarens were disqualified for technical infringements.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Qatar GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Qatar Airways Qatar Grand Prix'. Verstappen won again after a McLaren strategy blunder. Piastri took P2 and Carlos Sainz scored a podium for Williams in P3.

programme.desc: Prologue. The first contests on this year's edition of the Dakar took place at the gateway to the city of Bisha, on a terrain with a sequence of sandy tracks.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 1
programme.desc: Stage 1. Travelling south from Bisha, the air gets thinner and thinner as the road approaches 1,300 metres. The drop in oxygen levels is barely noticeable, but the landscape is no longer the same.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 2A
programme.desc: Stage 2A. The return journey to Bisha to complete the 48 HR Chrono expedition to the northeast of the city required passing through a 90-kilometre portion of grey dunes.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 2B
programme.desc: Stage 2B. The return journey to Bisha to complete the 48 HR Chrono expedition to the northeast of the city required passing through a 90-kilometre portion of grey dunes.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 3
programme.desc: Stage 3. The riders, drivers and crews dropped down by about 500 metres in altitude and especially had to tackle a beginning to the special that was very rocky, before picking up speed on sandy plateaus for approximately 200 kilometres.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 4
programme.desc: Stage 4. Prior to camping out in Berber tents, the competitors weaved their way around canyons, surged up rocky plateaus and turned on the afterburners on flat sandy expanses.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 5
programme.desc: Stage 5. The navigation was tricky on the last part of the special, where taking care of tyres was especially important on the terrain made up of large gravel.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Rest Day
programme.desc: Rest Day. 2025 will be the 47th edition of the Dakar Rally, organized by Amaury Sport Organisation (ASO), and the 6th time Saudi Arabia has hosted the event.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 6
programme.desc: Stage 6. Clarity of mind was essential to finding the way out of this maze of dunes ranging from white to saffron yellow depending on the angle of the light or the composition of the sand.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 7
programme.desc: Stage 7. The stage dazzled with views of Riyadh Province after rolling out of Al Duwadimi for a wide loop to the south-west of the city, stretching for a shade over 410 km.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 8
programme.desc: Stage 8. The day's special took place to the south of the capital, on split routes for the FIM and FIA vehicles, but both over distances of more than 480 kilometres.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 9
programme.desc: Stage 9. Over a distance of 357 kilometres and at a high pace requiring speedy roadbook reading, the main pitfalls to be concerned about was in regards to navigation.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 10
programme.desc: Stage 10. The field rolled out of Haradh to tackle a road section of more than 500 kilometres on route to the shores of the Arabian Gulf.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 11
programme.desc: Stage 11. There was a delay to the start of the stage which incited the bikers to request that the stage be shortened to 152km instead of the original 308km.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 12
programme.desc: Stage 12. The 47th edition of the Dakar and the 6th in Saudi Arabia was completed in Shubaytah by 175 vehicles - 77 bikes, 40 Ultimate cars, 1 Stock car, 21 Challengers, 23 SSVs and 13 trucks.
